item.title: Add My Supplied Voiceover

exact_text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

turns.text: Add a warm, clear English voice-over to this silent clip, saying exactly: “Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.” Keep the video unchanged. No music or captions.

item.tests: Tests adding an exact supplied narration to existing footage rather than returning standalone speech or regenerating the video.

answer_sheet.Voiceover wording: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
answer_sheet.Footage, aspect ratio, and duration: Use the attached silent clip, preserving its framing, sequence, and full 10-second duration.
answer_sheet.Lip synchronization: Not requested; leave the existing video unchanged.

must_haves: The deliverable is the attached kitchen-table video with an audible voice-over, not an audio-only file.
The narration says the supplied script exactly, without omissions, substitutions, or extra spoken words.
The entire narration is intelligible and finishes before the 10-second video ends.
The original footage, framing, and sequence remain unchanged.
There is no music or added on-screen text.

turns.text: Could you add a warm, clear English voice-over to the attached silent clip? I’m hoping this will make the morning advice feel a little more approachable. The voice-over should say exactly: “Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.” Please keep the video unchanged, including its framing, sequence, and full 10-second duration. I don’t have a particular voice identity or gender in mind, so that’s your call, and I’m not asking for lip synchronization. Please don’t add any music or captions.

dialog.agent:
I can't do this with the tools I have here without changing your video, so I haven't started anything or spent any credits.

**The problem:** None of my tools can lay a new audio track over an existing video and leave the picture as it is. Here's what the closest options would do instead:
- **Video joining** only puts clips one after another. It can't play a voice track over your clip.
- **The narration feature** only works on videos it creates from scratch, so your frames wouldn't stay the same.
- **Lip sync and the AI video editor** would redraw your frames, and you said you don't want lip sync.
- **Video translation** only works on a clip that already has speech.

None of these would keep your framing, sequence and 10-second length exactly as they are.

**What I can do:** I can make the voice-over on its own in a warm, clear English voice, reading your script word for word, with no music or captions. You'd get it as a separate file, and you'd add it to your clip in any basic video editor or app (CapCut, iMovie, Clipchamp and so on) by dropping it on the audio track. Your video would stay completely untouched that way.

Two things to know before I make it:
- **Format:** The voice-over is made by a video tool, so the voice may come inside a short video file rather than an audio-only file. You'd use only its sound, and most editors let you separate the audio in one step.
- **Cost:** It's charged at 24 credits per second of narration. Your script takes about 9–10 seconds to read, so it would cost roughly 220–240 credits. Your free account may not have that many, and if it doesn't, the job will be refused.

Would you like me to go ahead?
dialog.why: It explains it can't do the exact request, then offers an alternative with a credit cost and asks the user to confirm before going ahead.
dialog.user: Yes, please go ahead with the separate voice-over. That's a bit disappointing, but I can drop it onto the clip myself, so it's fine. Just make sure it reads the script word for word in a warm, clear English voice, and fits within the clip's full 10 seconds. Any voice is fine with me, and I'll keep my fingers crossed that my free account has enough credits.

turns.agent:
Unfortunately your free account doesn't have enough credits, so I couldn't make the voice-over. Magic Hour turned the job down before it started, so you weren't charged and nothing was created.

I had everything set up: your script word for word, a warm, clear, friendly English voice at a relaxed pace, and no music or captions. The voice would start about half a second in and finish within your 10 seconds. That job needs about **264 credits**, which is more than your account has right now.

**Ways forward:**
1. **Add credits and I'll run it again.** Buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan on Magic Hour would cover the ~264 credits. Tell me once that's done and I'll make the exact same voice-over.
2. **Use a free text-to-speech tool.** Many video editors have one built in, for example CapCut's "Text to speech" or Clipchamp's "Text to speech." You can paste your script straight in, pick a warm voice and place it on your clip. Your video stays completely unchanged, at no cost.

Sorry it didn't work out this time. Tell me if you add credits and I'll make it.
